statusHistory.note: Operator follow-up request (chat, 2026-09-21): a seventh São Carlos place, described simply as 'gelato bom, simples' (good gelato, unpretentious). Dubelato São Carlos is a branch of a 23-store Italian-style gelato chain founded in Poços de Caldas (Minas Gerais) in 2017, at R. Cap. Adão Pereira de Souza Cabral 883, Jardim Paraíso — directly in front of Igreja Nossa Senhora de Fátima, and about 75m down the same street from Caverna da Gordura (851), already published in this batch; genuinely a different venue (gelato vs. burger), not a near-duplicate, just a proximate one. Researched via Google Maps (live coordinates confirmed via Chrome, 4.7/97 reviews) and the official Instagram (@dubelatosaocarlos, ~13.1K followers, confirmed hours: Monday-Saturday 12pm-10pm, Sunday 11am-9pm). UGC quoted both ways, matching the 'simples' framing well: solid, unpretentious praise ('Gelato bom, atendimento excelente e lugar agradável') alongside two specific, real complaints — understaffing causing lines on a Friday afternoon, and one reviewer stating flatly that competitors offer tastier product at the same price. Both included rather than only the positive average. A limited-time pistachio 'Battuto Dubai' milkshake seen on Instagram expires 2026-09-22 (tomorrow relative to this write) — deliberately not featured as a current offer since it will be gone almost immediately; the body sticks to standing gelato rather than a menu item about to disappear. No genuine standing dated event found. Hero image is a real, recent (2 weeks old) official-Instagram photo of the venue's own gelato tubs — this location has no RestaurantGuru/aggregator coverage, same situation as Grano Ricco earlier in this batch. Given the deliberately modest 'simples' framing, this entry runs shorter than the rest of the batch with a single image rather than forcing a second.
